description: This file defines an authentication UI component for user login, signup, and logout operations using Svelte framework with TypeScript support. It manages auth state, handles user input, and communicates with an external authentication store.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Handles user sign-up process by calling auth.signup and updating UI state.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login process by calling auth.login and navigating upon success.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user by calling auth.logout and resetting form states.
